title: ARTEM server: an online tool for nucleic acid 3D motif searches; 3D structure superposition and structure-based alignment.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: The server homepage answers HTTP 200 (text/html). The Europe PMC supplement holds only 4 figure images (0.13 MB) and no data tables. No GEO, SRA or Zenodo records were found.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The server does motif search and structure alignment on uploaded PDB/mmCIF files (the standard 3D-structure file formats) and on the BGSU representative set of RNA structures. It keeps job outputs for 30 days. The paper releases no labelled dataset.

a1_downloadable.note: This is a web tool, not a dataset. The only downloads are per-job alignment outputs; the supplement is just figures (checked).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no label column. Any target, such as motif matches or alignment scores, would have to be built by running ARTEM yourself.

a3_inputs_present.note: The inputs would be PDB structures pulled from outside, not from this paper.

a4_units_stated.note: No data table exists, so there are no units to check.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: There are no counts to compare.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any label would be the ARTEM algorithm's own output, so a model would just copy the tool (circular).

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper releases a web tool, not labelled data.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use RNA 3D structures to predict which local structural motifs match, copying the motif-search tool's output.
plain_idea.train_on: Pairs of RNA 3D structure fragments taken from the Protein Data Bank. The number of examples is unknown because the paper releases none.
plain_idea.predict: Whether two fragments share the same 3D motif. The 'true answer' would be the ARTEM algorithm's output, not a lab measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: At most a faster stand-in for an existing algorithm. It would teach us nothing new about RNA biology.

ml_idea: None viable. Training a model to imitate ARTEM's motif matches would be circular.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because no dataset exists.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Supplement listing: figures only, no data (done).

verdict_reason: A web-server tool paper with no released labelled dataset. Any label would be the tool's own output, so it fails A1, A2 and A8 (no download, no label column, circular label).
